segments.text: Over the past several tutorials, we've performed a few separation techniques, those being filtration
segments.zh: 在前面几期教程中，我们做过几种分离技术，分别是过滤

segments.text: and extraction.
segments.zh: 和萃取。

segments.text: Now let's look at another one, distillation.
segments.zh: 现在我们来看另一种：蒸馏。

segments.text: This is a technique that is very common in chemistry labs as well as industry, as it
segments.zh: 这项技术在化学实验室和工业中都非常常见，因为它

segments.text: is an effective and inexpensive way to separate liquid components of a mixture by virtue of
segments.zh: 是一种有效又便宜的方法，可以根据混合物中液体组分

segments.text: their boiling points.
segments.zh: 沸点的不同把它们分离开。

segments.text: So this is different from extraction, where the two solvents were immiscible, and we could
segments.zh: 所以这和萃取不同，萃取时两种溶剂互不相溶，我们可以

segments.text: easily separate them with a separatory funnel.
segments.zh: 用分液漏斗轻松把它们分开。

segments.text: Here we have a mixture of miscible liquids that have sufficiently different boiling points,
segments.zh: 这里我们有一种可互溶液体的混合物，它们的沸点相差足够大，

segments.text: such that we can boil one and not the other.
segments.zh: 以至于我们可以让其中一种沸腾而另一种不沸腾。

segments.text: This is achieved by heating the mixture to a temperature above the boiling point of
segments.zh: 做法是把混合物加热到高于

segments.text: one component, but below the boiling point of the other, so that the liquid with the
segments.zh: 一种组分的沸点、但低于另一种组分沸点的温度，这样

segments.text: lower boiling point turns into vapor, leaving the other liquid behind.
segments.zh: 沸点较低的液体就会变成蒸气，而另一种液体留在原处。

segments.text: We can then collect, cool, and condense the vapor into a pure liquid on the other side
segments.zh: 然后我们可以在冷凝管另一侧的接收瓶中收集蒸气，

segments.text: of the condenser in a receiving flask.
segments.zh: 将其冷却、冷凝成纯净的液体。

segments.text: For this to be achieved, a significant difference in boiling point is required, otherwise too
segments.zh: 要做到这一点，需要沸点有明显差异，否则

segments.text: much of the other component will vaporize as well.
segments.zh: 另一种组分也会有太多被汽化。

segments.text: For a simple distillation setup, we'll need a heat source such as a hot plate or
segments.zh: 对于简单蒸馏装置，我们需要一个热源，比如加热板或

segments.text: Bunsen burner.
segments.zh: 本生灯。

segments.text: We'll also need a round bottom flask, a three-way adapter like this one, a thermometer
segments.zh: 我们还需要一个圆底烧瓶、一个像这样的三通接头、一个温度计

segments.text: adapter, a thermometer, a condenser, a vacuum adapter, and something with which to collect
segments.zh: 接头、一支温度计、一根冷凝管、一个真空接引管，以及用来收集

segments.text: the condensing vapor, also called the distillate, such as a beaker or Erlenmeyer flask.
segments.zh: 冷凝蒸气、也就是所谓馏出液的容器，比如烧杯或锥形瓶。

segments.text: We'll also need a support adapter for our round bottom flask, and some connector clips.
segments.zh: 我们还需要一个圆底烧瓶的支撑座，以及一些接头夹。

segments.text: Lastly, we'll need ring stands and some clamps.
segments.zh: 最后，我们还需要铁架台和一些夹子。

segments.text: To build the setup, let's start with our round bottom flask.
segments.zh: 搭建装置时，我们先从圆底烧瓶开始。

segments.text: We'll place it on a round bottom support and put that on a hot plate.
segments.zh: 我们把它放在圆底烧瓶支撑座上，再放到加热板上。

segments.text: On top of the flask, we can add the three-way adapter with a side arm like this.
segments.zh: 在烧瓶上方，我们可以装上像这样带侧臂的三通接头。

segments.text: We'll then connect the thermometer on top using a thermometer adapter.
segments.zh: 然后用温度计接头把温度计连接在顶部。

segments.text: We need to make sure that everything is sealed so that our vapor does not escape.
segments.zh: 我们要确保所有地方都密封好，这样蒸气就不会逸出。

segments.text: You can add some grease to the joints and turn them so everything fits well.
segments.zh: 你可以在磨口处涂一些润滑脂并转动它们，让所有部件都配合良好。

segments.text: Your thermometer should be placed at a level that is just a bit lower than your side arm
segments.zh: 温度计的位置应该略低于侧臂，

segments.text: to get an accurate measurement of the temperature of the vapor.
segments.zh: 这样才能准确测量蒸气的温度。

segments.text: Let's then secure our flask by clamping it at the top like this.
segments.zh: 然后我们像这样在顶部夹住烧瓶，把它固定好。

segments.text: Now on this arm of the three-way adapter, we can add the condenser.
segments.zh: 现在在三通接头的这个臂上，我们可以装上冷凝管。

segments.text: Since the condenser tends to fall off as gravity will cause it to slide down, we also
segments.zh: 由于冷凝管在重力作用下容易滑落，我们还

segments.text: need to secure it.
segments.zh: 需要把它固定住。

segments.text: We can do that by clamping our vacuum adapter like this and connecting it to the condenser.
segments.zh: 我们可以像这样夹住真空接引管，并把它连接到冷凝管上。

segments.text: We now have support on both sides.
segments.zh: 现在两侧都有支撑了。

segments.text: To keep the condenser cool, we will run cold water through this outer chamber.
segments.zh: 为了让冷凝管保持低温，我们会让冷水流过这个外层夹套。

segments.text: The vapor will move through the intersection of the condenser, and as it's being cooled
segments.zh: 蒸气会穿过冷凝管的内管，当它与

segments.text: by contact with the glass that has been cooled by the cold water in the outer section, it
segments.zh: 被外层冷水冷却的玻璃接触而被冷却时，它

segments.text: will begin to return to the liquid phase.
segments.zh: 就会开始变回液相。

segments.text: To enable the flow of cold water, on the bottom part of the condenser, let's connect
segments.zh: 为了让冷水流动，我们在冷凝管的下部连接

segments.text: a hose that brings in cold water from the tap.
segments.zh: 一根从水龙头引入冷水的软管。

segments.text: Then connect another hose where the water will exit on the top, and just let that empty into
segments.zh: 然后在顶部再连接一根出水软管，让水直接排入

segments.text: the sink.
segments.zh: 水槽。

segments.text: Let's then finish the setup by adding our collector underneath the end of the condenser
segments.zh: 最后，我们在冷凝管末端下方放上收集容器，

segments.text: to collect the distillate as it drips out.
segments.zh: 收集滴出的馏出液，装置就完成了。

segments.text: In this particular example, we are going to be using a graduated cylinder here because
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，我们这里要用量筒，因为

segments.text: we want to measure the volume of our distillate as time goes by.
segments.zh: 我们想随着时间推移测量馏出液的体积。

segments.text: So this is our complete setup.
segments.zh: 这就是我们完整的装置。

segments.text: Make sure you examine every joint to ensure that you have a tight seal.
segments.zh: 一定要检查每一个接口，确保密封严实。

segments.text: Also check your clamps and adapters to ensure that nothing is loose.
segments.zh: 还要检查夹子和接头，确保没有任何松动。

segments.text: We can further secure our setup by adding clips that look like this.
segments.zh: 我们还可以加上像这样的卡夹，进一步固定装置。

segments.text: These can be used to clamp all the joints together so that the glassware does not separate.
segments.zh: 这些卡夹可以把所有接口夹在一起，这样玻璃仪器就不会分开。

segments.text: You can now turn on the cold water and make sure that it flows smoothly through the condenser.
segments.zh: 现在你可以打开冷水，确保水顺畅地流过冷凝管。

segments.text: We are now ready to start the distillation.
segments.zh: 现在我们可以开始蒸馏了。

segments.text: Today we will be distilling a 50-50 mixture of isopropyl alcohol and water, with some
segments.zh: 今天我们要蒸馏的是异丙醇和水 50:50 的混合物，里面

segments.text: dye added to it.
segments.zh: 加了一些染料。

segments.text: That will give our solution some nice color.
segments.zh: 这会让我们的溶液带上漂亮的颜色。

segments.text: The boiling point of isopropyl alcohol is 82.5 degrees Celsius, while water is 100,
segments.zh: 异丙醇的沸点是 82.5 摄氏度，而水是 100 度，

segments.text: so the alcohol is the substance that will vaporize here.
segments.zh: 所以这里会汽化的是醇。

segments.text: Additionally, because the dye is much more soluble in water than in the alcohol, our
segments.zh: 此外，由于染料在水中的溶解度远大于在醇中的溶解度，我们的

segments.text: distillate will be clear, leaving all of the dye behind in the water, acting as a
segments.zh: 馏出液会是无色透明的，所有染料都留在水中，这可以作为

segments.text: visual confirmation that separation is occurring.
segments.zh: 分离正在进行的直观证据。

segments.text: When adding your solution to the round bottom flask, the liquid level should be around halfway
segments.zh: 把溶液加入圆底烧瓶时，液面应在烧瓶一半左右

segments.text: up the flask or lower, as we do not want any liquid to splatter up into the condenser.
segments.zh: 或更低，因为我们不希望有液体溅进冷凝管。

segments.text: Next, let's add a stirring bar so that we get even heating in our mixture.
segments.zh: 接下来，我们加入一个搅拌子，让混合物受热均匀。

segments.text: We can also add a boiling chip to make the mixture boil more calmly.
segments.zh: 我们还可以加一粒沸石，让混合物沸腾得更平稳。

segments.text: Let's turn on the stirring function and start out by stirring the solution at a
segments.zh: 我们打开搅拌功能，先以

segments.text: slow rate like this.
segments.zh: 像这样较慢的速度搅拌溶液。

segments.text: We don't want to go too slow or too fast, so let's put this one at around 5.
segments.zh: 我们不希望太慢也不希望太快，所以把这台调到 5 左右。

segments.text: Be sure to experiment with your stirring function, as different instruments will give
segments.zh: 一定要多试试你的搅拌功能，因为不同的仪器会给

segments.text: you different stirring speeds.
segments.zh: 你不同的搅拌速度。

segments.text: We can then double check that everything is connected, and that our water is running
segments.zh: 然后我们可以再检查一遍所有部件是否都连接好了，以及水是否在

segments.text: through the condenser.
segments.zh: 流过冷凝管。

segments.text: Now let's turn on the heater.
segments.zh: 现在我们打开加热器。

segments.text: We'll turn this up to a medium level to get even heating.
segments.zh: 我们把它调到中档，以便均匀加热。

segments.text: Do not use a high temperature because the solution will start bubbling violently when
segments.zh: 不要用高温，因为溶液沸腾时会开始

segments.text: it boils.
segments.zh: 剧烈冒泡。

segments.text: If that happens, lower the temperature or remove the heat source completely, and wait
segments.zh: 如果出现这种情况，就降低温度或完全移开热源，等到

segments.text: until everything cools down before you start again.
segments.zh: 一切都冷却下来后再重新开始。

segments.text: Also, the discrepancy in the two boiling points is not enormous, so we want to make sure
segments.zh: 另外，两者的沸点差距并不算很大，所以我们要确保

segments.text: we don't heat to a temperature so high that both substances end up boiling.
segments.zh: 加热温度不要高到两种物质都沸腾。

segments.text: If you set up the heating and stirring correctly, the mixture should soon come to a nice even
segments.zh: 如果你正确设置了加热和搅拌，混合物应该很快就会平稳均匀地

segments.text: boil.
segments.zh: 沸腾。

segments.text: Vapor will rise up into the three-way adapter, where it will start condensing.
segments.zh: 蒸气会上升到三通接头中，并开始在那里冷凝。

segments.text: Eventually, vapor will start collecting in the top arm of the condenser.
segments.zh: 最终，蒸气会开始聚集在冷凝管的上端。

segments.text: The vapor will then travel through the condenser where it will begin to condense, and this
segments.zh: 然后蒸气会穿过冷凝管并开始冷凝，这些

segments.text: liquid will start falling into the collection vessel.
segments.zh: 液体会开始落入收集容器。

segments.text: The isopropyl alcohol being collected is a highly flammable substance that can cause serious
segments.zh: 收集到的异丙醇是一种高度易燃的物质，会造成严重的

segments.text: eye irritation and damage to your skin, so if doing distillation of this type, make
segments.zh: 眼睛刺激并损伤皮肤，所以如果做这类蒸馏，一定

segments.text: sure you wear protective equipment and stay away from fire or sparks.
segments.zh: 要穿戴防护装备，并远离明火或火花。

segments.text: For this particular experiment, to add a component of data analysis, we can also collect some measurements.
segments.zh: 对于这个实验，为了加入数据分析的环节，我们还可以采集一些测量数据。

segments.text: For every milliliter of distillate collected, write down the total volume collected and
segments.zh: 每收集 1 毫升馏出液，就记下收集到的总体积以及

segments.text: the temperature of the vapor as shown by the thermometer.
segments.zh: 温度计显示的蒸气温度。

segments.text: We should keep collecting the distillate until we get the amount of alcohol we originally
segments.zh: 我们应该一直收集馏出液，直到得到我们最初

segments.text: measured and added to the mixture.
segments.zh: 量取并加入混合物中的那么多醇。

segments.text: The temperature should go up as the volume of distillate goes up.
segments.zh: 温度应该随着馏出液体积的增加而上升。

segments.text: This is because the composition of the mixture changes as more of one component is vaporized
segments.zh: 这是因为随着更多的某一组分被汽化

segments.text: and removed.
segments.zh: 并移除，混合物的组成在发生变化。

segments.text: When all the alcohol has been collected, the condensation should stop, and the temperature
segments.zh: 当所有的醇都被收集后，冷凝应该停止，温度

segments.text: should stop rising.
segments.zh: 也应该停止上升。

segments.text: A graph of your data for a simple distillation should look like this.
segments.zh: 简单蒸馏的数据图应该是这个样子。

segments.text: The temperature goes up as more distillate is collected, and it will level off after
segments.zh: 随着收集到的馏出液增多，温度上升，在

segments.text: we've removed all the alcohol.
segments.zh: 我们把所有醇都移除后，温度会趋于平稳。

segments.text: If you know the identity of your target compound as we do in this case, you should collect your
segments.zh: 如果你像我们这次一样知道目标化合物是什么，就应该一直收集

segments.text: distillate until you get to a range that is slightly above its boiling point.
segments.zh: 馏出液，直到温度略高于它的沸点。

segments.text: You can then change the flask when the temperature goes much higher than that.
segments.zh: 当温度远高于这个值时，你就可以更换烧瓶了。

segments.text: This is to avoid impurities that have a boiling point higher than your desired product, such
segments.zh: 这是为了避免混入沸点高于目标产物的杂质，比如

segments.text: as water in this case.
segments.zh: 本例中的水。

segments.text: And with that, we have completed a distillation in which we isolated isopropyl alcohol from
segments.zh: 这样，我们就完成了一次蒸馏，把异丙醇从

segments.text: the rest of the mixture.
segments.zh: 混合物的其余部分中分离了出来。

segments.text: And as expected, we can see how clear this is compared to our colored mixture.
segments.zh: 正如预期的那样，我们可以看到它与有颜色的混合物相比有多么清澈。

segments.text: When the boiling points of the components in the mixture are very close, we can also
segments.zh: 当混合物中各组分的沸点非常接近时，我们还可以

segments.text: use another method called fractional distillation.
segments.zh: 使用另一种方法，叫做分馏。

segments.text: This technique is similar to a simple distillation, except that we use a fractional column for
segments.zh: 这项技术与简单蒸馏类似，只是我们会让蒸气先经过一根分馏柱，

segments.text: the vapors to travel through before they hit the condenser.
segments.zh: 然后才到达冷凝管。

segments.text: This column contains layers of glass beads that improve the separation between the liquids
segments.zh: 这根柱子里有多层玻璃珠，可以提高待分离液体

segments.text: that are being separated.
segments.zh: 之间的分离效果。

segments.text: But for today, that's all we need to know about distillation.
segments.zh: 不过今天，关于蒸馏我们只需要了解这些。

segments.text: Let's move forward and examine some other techniques.
segments.zh: 让我们继续，来看看其他一些技术。
